name: cavemio-segmented-control
title: Segmented control
description: One of a few options side by side: the thumb is thrown to the new segment while its width eases to the new label.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Reduced motion: the thumb moves at once.
- Use Tabs when each choice shows its own panel.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: block
props.description: false · Fill the parent with equal segments.

useCases.title: Billing period

features.title: One thrown thumb
features.description: Measured from layout, retargets mid-flight, first placement without motion.

features.title: Radio semantics

states.title: pick
states.description: The thumb is thrown to the new segment (440ms, slight overshoot) and its width eases (400ms).

states.title: press
states.description: The thumb scales to 0.97 under the finger.

states.title: keys
states.description: Arrows move and select; Home and End jump.
